symbols.name: EventMap
symbols.description: Native events dispatched through `Events.on`. Each property is the exact callback argument tuple for that event. An event the server sends with `Player.emit` arrives as `[data: unknown]`.

properties.name: resourceStart
properties.description: Dispatched after a resource entry point has run and immediately before the resource becomes running.

properties.name: resourceStop
properties.description: Dispatched while a resource is stopping, before its stop callback, timers, exports and event handlers are cleaned up.

properties.name: chatMessage
properties.description: Dispatched before a server chat message is added to the built-in chat overlay.

properties.name: chatSend
properties.description: Dispatched synchronously when the local player submits a chat line. Return false to keep the line client-side. Chat.send bypasses this event; asynchronous handlers cannot block it.

properties.name: voiceStart
properties.description: Dispatched when the local player starts speaking on voice chat. A held push-to-talk key with no speech does not trigger it.

properties.name: voiceStop
properties.description: Dispatched when the local player stops speaking.

properties.name: missionReady
properties.description: Dispatched once the native mission has loaded, after the server's weather and frame overrides were applied.

properties.name: missionUnload
properties.description: Dispatched while the native mission closes. Local sounds and HUD state are cleared right after.

properties.name: render
properties.description: Dispatched once per client update while a mission is loaded. Submit Draw commands here; the queue is cleared before the next update.

properties.name: playerStreamIn
properties.description: Dispatched when a player's replica reaches this client, including the local player.

properties.name: playerStreamOut
properties.description: Dispatched once a player's replica has left this client; its handles no longer resolve.

properties.name: playerSpawn
properties.description: Dispatched when a streamed player starts a new life.

properties.name: playerDeath
properties.description: Dispatched when a streamed player's server health reaches zero.

properties.name: pickupStreamIn
properties.description: Dispatched when a weapon pickup for the loaded mission reaches this client.

properties.name: pickupStreamOut
properties.description: Dispatched when a weapon pickup leaves this client or its mission unloads. The handle no longer resolves; lastKnown is a plain snapshot from the last replicated update.

properties.name: doorStreamIn
properties.description: Dispatched when a mission door replica reaches this client.

properties.name: doorChange
properties.description: Dispatched after a replicated mission door's target, lock or native use state changes.

properties.name: doorStreamOut
properties.description: Dispatched when a mission door replica leaves or its mission unloads.

properties.name: countdownEnd
properties.description: Dispatched when a countdown started with Hud.startCountdown runs out.

properties.name: entityStateChange
properties.description: Dispatched when one key of an entity's state changes: on the server when a script writes it, on a client when the write arrives. `value` is undefined when the key was removed and `previous` is undefined when it held nothing before, so a stored null stays distinguishable from an absent key. The entity is whatever the game's WrapScriptEntity answers, and the base Entity handle by default.

type.name: [entity: Entity, key: string, value: any, previous: any]

properties.name: browserCreated
properties.description: Dispatched once per view, before any navigation, to the resource that created it.

properties.name: browserLoadingStart
properties.description: Dispatched when any frame of an owned view begins loading.

properties.name: browserDocumentReady
properties.description: Dispatched when an owned view's main document is ready; the earliest point at which the page can receive Web.emit.

properties.name: browserLoadingFailed
properties.description: Dispatched when a frame of an owned view fails to load.

properties.name: browserNavigate
properties.description: Dispatched for every navigation an owned view is asked to perform, refused or not.

properties.name: browserPopup
properties.description: Dispatched when an owned view blocks a popup; windowless views cannot host one, so handle the URL yourself.

properties.name: browserCursorChange
properties.description: Dispatched when an owned view's requested cursor shape changes.

properties.name: browserTooltip
properties.description: Dispatched when an owned view requests a tooltip; windowless rendering draws none, so the script must.

properties.name: browserInputFocusChange
properties.description: Dispatched when focus enters or leaves an editable element of an owned view; use it to stop routing keys to the game.

properties.name: browserResourceBlocked
properties.description: Dispatched when an owned view rejects a navigation or a page event from outside its locked origin.

properties.name: browserConsoleMessage
properties.description: Dispatched for console output of an owned view; the framework logs these regardless.

properties.name: browserOriginChange
properties.description: Dispatched on view creation and whenever Web.loadURL re-locks an owned view to a different origin.

properties.name: author

properties.name: color

symbols.name: Player
symbols.description: A streamed Mafia 1 player, local or remote. Every value is the server state this client last received; a handle stops resolving once the player leaves.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a handle for a streamed player; throws when the ID does not resolve to a player.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this player for logging.

returns.description: The player ID and nickname.

functions.name: getVehicle
functions.description: Returns the streamed vehicle the player sits in.

returns.description: The vehicle, or null on foot.

functions.name: getSeat
functions.description: Returns the seat the player occupies.

returns.description: The seat index (0 is the driver), or -1 on foot.

properties.name: nickname
properties.description: Server nickname.

properties.name: model
properties.description: Server-selected native human model file, such as "Tommy.i3d"; empty after the player streams out.

properties.name: health
properties.description: Server health from 0 to 100.

properties.name: money
properties.description: Last replicated server-owned Free Ride balance. Read only, including for the local player.

properties.name: alive
properties.description: Whether the player is spawned and alive.

properties.name: spawned
properties.description: Whether the player has a life in the current mission.

properties.name: isLocal
properties.description: Whether this is the player this client controls.

properties.name: missionGeneration
properties.description: Mission generation of the current life.

properties.name: spawnGeneration
properties.description: Generation of the current life; it increases on every spawn.

symbols.name: Vehicle
symbols.description: A streamed server vehicle. Every value is the server state this client last received.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a handle for a streamed vehicle; throws when the ID does not resolve to a vehicle.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this vehicle for logging.

returns.description: The vehicle ID and model.

functions.name: getOccupant
functions.description: Returns the player in a seat.

returns.description: The player, or null for an empty seat.

functions.name: getOccupants
functions.description: Lists the seated players.

returns.description: Every streamed occupant in seat order.

properties.name: model
properties.description: Native model file, such as "fordtl00.i3d".

properties.name: health
properties.description: Server health from 0 to 100.

properties.name: engineOn
properties.description: Whether the engine runs.

properties.name: sirenOn
properties.description: Whether the siren sounds.

properties.name: hornOn
properties.description: Whether the horn sounds.

properties.name: fuel
properties.description: Fuel in the tank.

properties.name: opacity
properties.description: Server-authored model opacity, 0 transparent and 1 opaque.

properties.name: gear
properties.description: Current gear; 0 is neutral.

properties.name: seatCount
properties.description: Number of seats.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this pickup for logging.

returns.description: The pickup ID and weapon, or gone when it has streamed out.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Replicated pickup position. Read only on the client.

properties.name: rotation
properties.description: Facing derived from heading. Read only on the client.

properties.name: weaponId
properties.description: Weapon lying here.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Facing in radians.

properties.name: loaded
properties.description: Loaded rounds or throwable count.

properties.name: reserve
properties.description: Reserve rounds.

properties.name: missionGeneration
properties.description: Server generation of the mission containing this pickup.

symbols.name: Door
symbols.description: Read-only view of a server-managed mission door, including its paired leaf's shared target state.

constructor.name: constructor

functions.name: toString

properties.name: position

properties.name: intensity

properties.name: cityMusic

symbols.name: ClientMissionFrame

symbols.name: World
symbols.description: Read-only view of the mission and the entities streamed to this client. The server owns the world; change it from a server script.

functions.name: getPlayers
functions.description: Lists the players streamed to this client, including the local one.

returns.description: Every streamed player.

functions.name: getVehicles
functions.description: Lists the vehicles streamed to this client.

returns.description: Every streamed vehicle.

functions.name: getPickups
functions.description: Lists the weapon pickups streamed into the loaded mission.

returns.description: Script-created and dropped pickups in this mission; empty while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: getDoors
functions.description: Lists the mission doors the server is synchronizing.

returns.description: Empty before a mission has loaded.

functions.name: getMission
functions.description: Returns the loaded stock mission.

returns.description: The mission name, or null while none is loaded.

functions.name: getMissionGeneration
functions.description: Returns the server generation of the loaded mission.

returns.description: The generation, or 0 while none is loaded.

functions.name: isReady
functions.description: Whether the native mission is loaded.

returns.description: True while a mission runs.

functions.name: getWeather
functions.description: Returns the replicated weather and city music state.

returns.description: The weather preset, intensity and city music flag.

functions.name: getNightMode
functions.description: Reads the loaded native mission's effective night flag.

returns.description: Null before the mission is ready.

functions.name: getMissionFrame
functions.description: Reads a named frame's world position and direction from the loaded mission.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Native scene frame name, such as the Free Ride spawn anchor emeth_1.

returns.description: A snapshot, or null when the frame or mission is unavailable.

functions.name: findWorldFrame
functions.description: Finds a borrowed, read-only native mission frame. Its getters resolve fresh values on every call.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Native scene frame name, such as emeth_1.

returns.description: A live Frame handle, or null when the frame or mission is unavailable.

symbols.name: Hud
symbols.description: The retail Mafia 1 HUD for this client. Every call returns false while no mission is loaded, and the game clears the watch, score and compass on every mission change.

functions.name: showMessage
functions.description: Adds a line to the native HUD console, which keeps the last five lines for five seconds each.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Message line; at most 127 characters are shown.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: announce
functions.description: Shows large white centred text, the race flash text, fading out over its last second.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Announcement; at most 127 characters are shown.

parameters.name: durationSeconds
parameters.description: How long it stays; defaults to 3.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: showWatch
functions.description: Shows the mission watch running in real time from this clock time.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: startCountdown
functions.description: Shows the watch with its countdown wedge. The countdownEnd event fires when it runs out.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Countdown length in whole seconds; 0 removes the countdown.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: getCountdown
functions.description: Returns the seconds left on the countdown.

returns.description: The remaining seconds, or null when no countdown runs.

functions.name: hideWatch
functions.description: Hides the watch and stops its countdown without firing countdownEnd.

functions.name: setScore
functions.description: Shows the freeride score counter with this value.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: addScore
functions.description: Adds to the score counter and shows it.

returns.description: The new score, or null while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: getScore
functions.description: Reads the native Free Ride score value, even while its counter is hidden. Retail scripts may change it locally.

returns.description: The score, or null while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: isScoreVisible
functions.description: Reads whether the native Free Ride score counter is shown.

returns.description: True or false, or null while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: setScoreVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides the native Free Ride score counter without changing its value.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: Whether to show the existing score value.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: hideScore
functions.description: Hides the score counter without changing its value.

functions.name: setCompassTarget
functions.description: Points the native compass arrow at a target.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: A fixed point, or a streamed player or vehicle the arrow follows.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number } | Player | Vehicle

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded or the entity is not streamed.

functions.name: clearCompassTarget
functions.description: Hides the compass arrow.

symbols.name: Fade
symbols.description: The retail full-screen fade, drawn over the scene and the HUD.

functions.name: out
functions.description: Fades the screen to a color and holds it until Fade.in.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: 0xRRGGBB color to fade to; defaults to black.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: in
functions.description: Fades from a color back to the scene.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: 0xRRGGBB color to fade from; defaults to black.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

symbols.name: Camera
symbols.description: The retail game camera.

functions.name: setSwing
functions.description: Rolls the camera and the sky slowly from side to side, the retail boat swing. Mafia 1 has no camera shake.

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: Roll strength from 0 to 100, as the retail CAMERA_SETSWING script command takes it; 0 stops the swing.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

functions.name: getFov
functions.description: Returns the active camera's effective field of view in degrees.

returns.description: Null while no active mission camera exists.

functions.name: setFov
functions.description: Sets the active camera's field of view through the retail widescreen-aware CAMERA_SETFOV path.

parameters.name: degrees
parameters.description: Field of view from 1 to 179 degrees.

returns.description: False while no active mission camera exists. Camera modes may subsequently update the value.

functions.name: setRange
functions.description: Sets the active camera's clip planes with the retail CAMERA_SETRANGE setter.

parameters.name: nearClip
parameters.description: Near clip plane in world units, 0.01 to 10.

parameters.name: farClip
parameters.description: Far clip plane above nearClip and at most 5000 world units.

returns.description: False while no active mission camera exists. Camera modes may subsequently update the values.

functions.name: lock
functions.description: Locks the camera at a world position and direction, as CAMERA_LOCK does with a frame. Call Camera.unlock to resume following the player.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Fixed camera position in world coordinates.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Nonzero forward direction; normalized before use.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

returns.description: False while no active mission camera exists or direction is zero. A new local life or mission close restores the player camera.

functions.name: unlock
functions.description: Returns from a camera lock to the previous player camera mode and refreshes the light cache.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

symbols.name: Sound
symbols.description: Sounds only this client hears. The game releases a sound once it has played; a looping one plays until Sound.stop or the mission closes. Use the server Sound class for sounds everyone hears.

functions.name: play
functions.description: Plays a non-positional sound.

parameters.name: wave
parameters.description: Game sound file under the Sounds directory or its archives, such as "00_dog.wav".

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Volume 0 to 1 (default 1) and whether it loops (at most 32 loops).

returns.description: The sound id, or null when the file is missing or no mission is loaded.

functions.name: playAt
functions.description: Plays a positional sound.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Radius 1 to 200 (default 25), volume 0 to 1 and looping.

type.name: { radius?: number; volume?: number; loop?: boolean }

returns.description: The sound id, or null when the file is missing or no mission is loaded.

functions.name: stop
functions.description: Stops a sound.

returns.description: False while no mission is loaded.

symbols.name: Frame
symbols.description: Live handle to a native scene frame in the loaded mission. Named world frames are borrowed and read-only; local frames belong to their creating resource. Handles expire on mission unload or resource stop.

functions.name: isValid
functions.description: Checks whether the frame still resolves in this mission and resource.

returns.description: False after mission unload, resource stop, local destruction, or a removed named frame.

functions.name: getWorldPosition
functions.description: Reads the current world position through the native world matrix.

returns.description: Null after this handle expires.

functions.name: getWorldDirection
functions.description: Reads the current normalized world forward direction.

returns.description: Null after this handle expires.

functions.name: getRotation
functions.description: Reads the frame's local quaternion rotation.

returns.description: Null after this handle expires.

type.name: { w: number; x: number; y: number; z: number } | null

functions.name: getScale
functions.description: Reads the frame's local scale.

returns.description: Null after this handle expires.

functions.name: setWorldPosition
functions.description: Moves an owned local frame in world space; borrowed mission frames are read-only.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

returns.description: False for a read-only or expired frame.

functions.name: setRotation
functions.description: Sets an owned local frame's local quaternion rotation.

type.name: { w: number; x: number; y: number; z: number }

returns.description: False for a read-only or expired frame.

functions.name: setDirection
functions.description: Points an owned local frame forward; human directions remain horizontal.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

returns.description: False for a read-only or expired frame.

functions.name: setScale
functions.description: Sets an owned model or dummy frame's local scale. Native human actor scale is fixed.

type.name: number | Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

returns.description: False for a read-only, human, or expired frame.

functions.name: setVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides an owned local frame.

returns.description: False for a read-only or expired frame.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Releases an owned local frame.

returns.description: False for a borrowed or expired frame.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Frame name at the time this handle was created.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Legacy numeric ID for an owned local frame; null for a borrowed mission frame.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: True for a named mission frame; its setters and destroy return false.

symbols.name: Scene
symbols.description: Client-local mission frames for visual effects. Handles do not replicate and are invalid after mission unload.

functions.name: createModel
functions.description: Loads a stock .i3d as a non-interactive local model. Returns null if unavailable or the 128-frame cap is reached.

functions.name: canUseHumanModel
functions.description: Checks that the stock model loads and has the complete skeleton required by native human collision and animation.

returns.description: False for a missing or non-human model, or before mission load.

functions.name: createDummy
functions.description: Creates a local dummy frame; it has no mesh or collision.

functions.name: createModelFrame
functions.description: Loads a stock .i3d as a local model and returns a live Frame object.

functions.name: createDummyFrame
functions.description: Creates an invisible local dummy and returns a live Frame object.

functions.name: createHumanFrame
functions.description: Creates a local human and returns its live Frame. Use frame.id with Scene.playHumanAnimation or Scene.setHumanIdle.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }
Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

parameters.name: solid
parameters.description: Native collision on this client; defaults to false.

functions.name: getFrame
functions.description: Wraps an existing owned numeric local frame handle in the common Frame interface.

functions.name: createHuman
functions.description: Creates a stationary local C_entity with a validated stock human model. Native animation still ticks. Up to 24 local humans; no network replication or server-side interaction.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }
Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

parameters.name: solid
parameters.description: Native collision on this client; defaults to false.

functions.name: playHumanAnimation
functions.description: Plays a stock .i3d clip on a local human; loop defaults to false. Returns false for a missing animation or expired handle.

functions.name: setHumanIdle
functions.description: Stops a local human clip and restores the stock idle animation.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Releases a local frame and invalidates its handle.

functions.name: setPosition
functions.description: Sets a frame's world position.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

functions.name: setRotation
functions.description: Sets a frame's full rotation as a normalized quaternion.

type.name: { w: number; x: number; y: number; z: number }

functions.name: setDirection
functions.description: Points a frame forward; human directions stay horizontal.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

functions.name: setScale
functions.description: Sets uniform or per-axis scale.

type.name: number | Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

functions.name: setVisible
functions.description: Toggles a local frame.

functions.name: projectWorld
functions.description: Projects a point into screen pixels. With occlusion enabled, static world geometry blocks visibility.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

symbols.name: WorldProjection
symbols.description: Projection of a world point into the current game viewport.

properties.name: x
properties.description: Screen pixel X, or null when off screen or behind the camera.

properties.name: y
properties.description: Screen pixel Y, or null when off screen or behind the camera.

properties.name: onScreen
properties.description: Point is in front of the camera and inside the viewport.

properties.name: occluded
properties.description: Static world geometry blocks the point when occlusion was requested.

properties.name: visible
properties.description: onScreen and not occluded.

symbols.name: Draw
symbols.description: Per-frame native overlay primitives in screen pixels. Call from Events.on('render'). Colors are 0xAARRGGBB.

functions.name: rect
functions.description: Queues a filled rectangle.

functions.name: line
functions.description: Queues a line.

functions.name: circle
functions.description: Queues a filled circle.

functions.name: text
functions.description: Queues centered native text. Font indices 0..3 are the game's built-in faces.

functions.name: worldText
functions.description: Projects and queues centered text only when on screen and not blocked by static world geometry.

type.name: Vector3 | { x: number; y: number; z: number }

symbols.name: Vector2
symbols.description: Mutable two-dimensional vector exposed as the global Vector2.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a vector from two numeric components.

functions.name: add
functions.description: Adds another vector to this vector in place.

returns.description: This mutated vector for chaining.

functions.name: sub
functions.description: Subtracts another vector from this vector in place.

returns.description: This mutated vector for chaining.

functions.name: mul
functions.description: Multiplies this vector by a scalar in place.

returns.description: This mutated vector for chaining.

functions.name: div
functions.description: Divides this vector by a scalar in place.

parameters.name: scalar
parameters.description: Divisor applied to both components; must be non-zero.

returns.description: This mutated vector for chaining.

functions.name: dot
functions.description: Computes the dot product without changing either vector.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Vector used for the dot product.

returns.description: Scalar dot product.

functions.name: normalize
functions.description: Normalizes this vector in place; a zero vector remains unchanged.

returns.description: This mutated vector for chaining.

functions.name: lerp
functions.description: Linearly interpolates this vector toward a target in place.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Interpolation factor; 0 keeps the current value and 1 reaches target.

returns.description: This mutated vector for chaining.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Replaces both components in place.

returns.description: This mutated vector for chaining.

functions.name: distance
functions.description: Computes Euclidean distance to another vector.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Vector to measure from this vector.

returns.description: Distance between the two vectors.

functions.name: clone
functions.description: Creates an independent copy of this vector.

returns.description: New vector with the same components.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this vector for logging and debugging.

returns.description: Text in Vector2(x, y) form.

functions.name: toJSON
functions.description: Converts this vector to a plain object for JSON.stringify.

returns.description: Object containing the current components.

symbols.name: Voice
symbols.description: Local player's proximity voice chat settings: on/off, playback volume, hearing range and the push-to-talk binding.

functions.name: setEnabled
functions.description: Turns voice chat on or off. Off closes the microphone and playback devices and tells the server to stop relaying voice to this client.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether voice chat runs at all for this player.

functions.name: isEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether voice chat is enabled for this player.

returns.description: True unless the player turned voice chat off.

functions.name: setVolume
functions.description: Sets the playback volume of incoming voice. A game that plays voice through its own audio engine applies the same gain there.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Playback gain, where 1 is unattenuated. Clamped to 0..4.

functions.name: getVolume
functions.description: Reads the voice playback volume.

returns.description: Current gain, where 1 is unattenuated.

functions.name: setHearingRange
functions.description: Narrows how far this player hears others. Can only reduce the server's range, since a talker beyond it is never relayed.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Audibility radius in world units; 0 removes the local limit.

functions.name: getHearingRange
functions.description: Reads the local hearing-range limit.

returns.description: Radius in world units, or 0 when the server's range applies unreduced.

functions.name: getRange
functions.description: Reads the server's proximity range for talkers with no override of their own.

returns.description: Radius in world units.

functions.name: setPushToTalkKey
functions.description: Rebinds push-to-talk. Unknown key names throw.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Case-insensitive key name, using the same names as Key.bind.

functions.name: getPushToTalkKey
functions.description: Reads the push-to-talk binding.

returns.description: Canonical key name, e.g. "v".

functions.name: setPushToTalkReleaseDelay
functions.description: Sets how long transmission continues after push-to-talk is released, so letting go slightly early does not clip the end of a word. Muting, turning voice off and losing input focus still stop it at once.

parameters.name: milliseconds
parameters.description: How long to keep transmitting after the key goes up. Clamped to 0..2000.

functions.name: getPushToTalkReleaseDelay
functions.description: Reads the push-to-talk release delay.

returns.description: Delay in milliseconds; 0 when transmission stops the moment the key is released.

functions.name: isTalking
functions.description: Checks whether the local player is speaking right now. The same state raises the voiceStart and voiceStop events.

returns.description: True while push-to-talk is open -- held, or still inside the release delay -- and the microphone is producing audio.

functions.name: hasMicrophone
functions.description: Checks whether a capture device opened for this session.

returns.description: False when the player has no working microphone, i.e. they are listen-only.

functions.name: setTransmitMode
functions.description: Chooses what opens the microphone. Switching closes whatever the previous mode had open. Unknown modes throw.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: pushToTalk sends while the key is held; voiceActivity sends whenever the microphone is louder than the activation threshold.

functions.name: getTransmitMode
functions.description: Reads what opens the microphone.

returns.description: The current transmit mode.

functions.name: setActivationThreshold
functions.description: Sets the voice-activation sensitivity: lower sends quieter speech, higher ignores more background noise. Clamped to 0..1.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Microphone level, 0 to 1 on the scale getInputLevel reports, above which voice activation sends.

functions.name: getActivationThreshold
functions.description: Reads the voice-activation threshold.

returns.description: Level from 0 to 1.

functions.name: getInputLevel
functions.description: Reads how loud the microphone is right now, whether or not anything is being sent -- the value to draw a level meter from and to tune the activation threshold against.

returns.description: Smoothed level from 0 to 1; 0 while no microphone is open.

functions.name: setNoiseSuppression
functions.description: Turns noise suppression on or off. It runs before the level is measured, so it also keeps steady noise from tripping voice activation.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether to filter background noise out of the microphone.

functions.name: isNoiseSuppressionEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether noise suppression is on.

returns.description: True while background noise is being filtered.

functions.name: getInputDevices
functions.description: Lists the microphones voice can record from.

returns.description: Device names as the player would recognise them; empty when the game chooses the device itself.

functions.name: setInputDevice
functions.description: Chooses the microphone. A running microphone is reopened on the new device; a device that is no longer connected falls back to the default.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A name from getInputDevices, or an empty string for the system default.

functions.name: getInputDevice
functions.description: Reads the chosen microphone.

returns.description: Its name, or an empty string for the system default.

symbols.name: Nametags
symbols.description: The local player's view of the nametags above other players: whether they draw at all, and whether they carry a health bar.

functions.name: setVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides all nametags for this player only. A player hidden with Player.setNametagVisible stays hidden either way.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: True to draw nametags, false to hide every one of them.

functions.name: isVisible
functions.description: Checks whether this player draws nametags.

returns.description: True unless they were hidden locally.

functions.name: setHealthVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides the health bar on all nametags for this player only, leaving the names alone.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: True to draw the health bar under each name, false to hide it.

functions.name: isHealthVisible
functions.description: Checks whether this player draws health bars on nametags.

returns.description: True unless they were hidden locally.

functions.name: setLabel
functions.description: Hangs a transient line on that entity's nametag, above its name -- speech, an emote, a status. It follows the body, fades with distance and hides behind cover exactly as the name does. Local to this player: the line is not replicated, and a nametag hidden with Nametags.setVisible draws neither. Player.setNametagText is the server-side counterpart for a lasting name.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Network id of the entity to label (server-side `player.id`).

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Label text; '\n' splits lines. Empty clears the label.

parameters.name: durationMs
parameters.description: How long to hold it (default 6000). <= 0 holds until cleared.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Packed 0xAARRGGBB; 0 (default) uses the nametag's own colour.

functions.name: clearLabel
functions.description: Removes an entity's label before its duration elapses.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Network id of the entity whose label to remove.

functions.name: clearLabels
functions.description: Removes every label this player is drawing.

symbols.name: Entity
symbols.description: Base handle for a live replicated network entity.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a script wrapper for an existing entity with this ID; it does not spawn an entity.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this entity handle for logging and debugging.

returns.description: Text containing the network entity ID.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Immutable network entity identifier.

properties.name: virtualWorld
properties.description: Current virtual-world identifier.

properties.name: position
properties.description: Authoritative world-space position; assignment forces replicated state.

properties.name: rotation
properties.description: Authoritative rotation; reads return a quaternion and assignments accept a quaternion or Euler angles in degrees.

properties.name: state
properties.description: Arbitrary key/value state carried by this entity. The server writes it and every client that can see the entity receives it; see StateBag.

symbols.name: StateBag
symbols.description: Arbitrary key/value state attached to one replicated entity, reached as `entity.state`. Keys set on the server replicate to every client that can currently see the entity.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Reads one key from this entity's state.

returns.description: The stored value, or undefined when the key is not set.

functions.name: has
functions.description: Checks whether this entity's state holds a key.

returns.description: True when the key is set.

functions.name: keys
functions.description: Lists the keys this entity's state holds, sorted.

returns.description: Every key currently set, in ascending order.

functions.name: toObject
functions.description: Copies this entity's whole state into a plain object.

returns.description: Every key and value currently set. The copy does not track later changes.

functions.name: onChange
functions.description: Watches this entity's state. The filter is applied before the handler runs, so a listener watching one key of one entity is not woken by unrelated changes. The subscription is dropped when the registering resource stops.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only report this key, or null to report every key of this entity.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: Called as (key: string, value: any, previous: any) with the changed key, its new value and the value before it. `value` is undefined when the key was removed and `previous` is undefined when it held nothing.

returns.description: A zero-argument function that cancels this subscription.

symbols.name: BasePlayer
symbols.description: Framework-owned base handle for a connected player, extended by each game or mod.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a wrapper for an existing connected player with this ID; it does not connect or spawn a player.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this player handle for logging and debugging.

returns.description: Text containing the player's network entity ID.

functions.name: isNametagVisible
functions.description: Checks whether this player's nametag is shown to other players.

returns.description: True unless the nametag was hidden; false also when this game has no nametags.

functions.name: isNametagHealthVisible
functions.description: Checks whether the health bar under this player's nametag is shown.

returns.description: True unless the health bar was hidden; false also when this game has no nametags.

functions.name: getNametagText
functions.description: Reads this player's nametag text override.

returns.description: The override, or an empty string when the player's own name is drawn.

functions.name: getNametagColor
functions.description: Reads this player's nametag color.

returns.description: Packed 0xAARRGGBB color; opaque white when untinted.

variables.name: LocalPlayer
variables.description: The player this client controls, or null before the server created it.
